publication.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill seven after Hezbollah drone attack
publication.summary: Lebanese authorities reported seven deaths in Israeli strikes across southern Lebanon after Hezbollah launched drones toward Israeli troops. Israel said it targeted Hezbollah military infrastructure; Lebanon's president accused Israel of striking civilian facilities.
publication.body:
Israeli strikes across southern Lebanon on September 6 killed seven people, including two women, according to Lebanese authorities, after Hezbollah launched two drones toward Israeli soldiers in the security zone Israel maintains in southern Lebanon. Reuters and other reporting described multiple strikes in and around Nabatieh and Arab Salim, with additional injuries reported.

publication.title: Netanyahu orders unauthorized West Bank outposts dismantled amid U.S. pressure
publication.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered unauthorized settler outposts dismantled, according to Reuters and Israeli reporting, as U.S. Ambassador Mike Huckabee publicly pressed Israel to confront violent settler attacks.
publication.body:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered unauthorized settler outposts in the West Bank to be dismantled, according to Reuters, citing two people familiar with the matter, and parallel Israeli reporting. The order comes amid heightened U.S. pressure on Israel to address attacks by violent settlers against Palestinians.

publication.title: Ben-Gurion University aerogel can absorb 100 times its weight in oil and support biodegradation
publication.summary: A Ben-Gurion University team developed a cellulose-based aerogel that rapidly captures oil while providing nutrients and a surface for oil-degrading bacteria, combining physical cleanup with biological breakdown.
publication.body:
Researchers at Ben-Gurion University of the Negev have developed a cellulose-based aerogel designed to both capture oil pollution and help microorganisms break it down. In laboratory experiments reported by the university, the material adsorbed roughly 100 times its own weight in crude oil, fuel and other hydrocarbons.
